label: YouTube Shorts
note: These view ids are best-effort guesses. Open Shorts, hit Dump on the Debug screen, and replace this list with what the dump actually shows for your YouTube build.

label: YouTube Shorts (description fallback)
note: Off by default and deliberately so: the word Shorts also appears on the bottom-nav tab button, which is present on the home feed. minAreaFraction 0.5 is what stops that, but verify against a dump of the home screen before enabling, or you will block all of YouTube.

label: Instagram Reels
note: Instagram renames these more often than YouTube does. Expect to re-dump after app updates.

label: Facebook Reels
note: Facebook is Litho-rendered and mostly ships no resource ids, so there is nothing reliable to match on. This rule is a heuristic and starts disabled. If a dump confirms nothing usable, switch to the fb-whole-app rule below instead - a whole-app budget is the honest fallback.

label: Facebook (whole app budget)
note: Fallback for when section detection inside Facebook proves unreliable.

label: TikTok
note: Whole app, zero budget: TikTok is nothing but the feed, so there is no section worth separating out. Zero budget means block on sight.

label: Snapchat Spotlight
note: Enable only if you actually use Snapchat; unverified selectors.

label: YouTube Shorts in a browser
note: Closes the obvious loophole of opening Shorts in a browser tab instead of the app. Matches the URL text in the omnibox.
